sources.excerpt: Soul POG Overdrive / Octave Multi-Effect Not Sold Online Find Dealer Item SOUL POG WILL BE DISCONTINUED Combines two sweet pedals—-the Soul Food transparent overdrive and Nano POG polyphonic octave generator—-in one potent multi-effect. Use them alone or together, put either first in the chain, insert other pedals between them with the FX loop. Also includes a cool Mode switch for a choice of two different octave-up sounds. The versatile Soul POG delivers award-winning overdrive and flawless polyphonic octaves in any combination! Quick Specs - Multi-effect pedal combines the Soul Food transparent OD and Nano POG polyphonic octave generator - Soul Food delivers transparent overdrive with great touch, response and headroom - Nano POG features a polyphonic sub-octave and octave up with flawless tracking - Use either effect alone or combine them in any order - Choose between two different octave-up sounds - Built-in FX loop - Includes EHX 9.6DC-200mA PSU Demo Video User Manual: https://www.ehx.com/soul-pog-manual.pdf Shipping Weight: 1.95 lbs.
